test_cases.name: Initial unbound state check without existing state file
test_cases.assertion: Returns UNBOUND status when state file does not exist, without error

test_cases.name: Negative check: foreign host IP is rejected
test_cases.assertion: Throws error when DB URL attempts to connect to 192.168.1.50

test_cases.name: Negative check: remote domain is rejected
test_cases.assertion: Throws error when API URL attempts to connect to remote domain example.supabase.co

test_cases.name: Negative check: swapped or mismatched port is rejected
test_cases.assertion: Throws error when DB port is not 54322

test_cases.name: Negative check: malformed protocol is rejected
test_cases.assertion: Throws error when protocol is not postgresql:/postgres:

test_cases.name: Negative check: missing or altered config file is rejected
test_cases.assertion: Throws error when supabase/config.toml is missing or project_id != lingora-local-dev

test_cases.name: Canary secret and token redaction across all fields
test_cases.assertion: Zero canary secrets, JWTs, or passwords appear in projected/sanitized state

test_cases.name: Process and network spy test: forbidden target checks trigger NO network or spawn calls
test_cases.assertion: Zero network connections or subprocess spawns are attempted when validating invalid targets

review_findings_addressed: G0-R1: Bound canonical task/workspace/config/state root, exact instance ID, required endpoint set and ports. Fails closed before network/process invocation.
G0-R2: Complete canary secret/JWT/password redaction verified across all state inspection paths.
